title: The "operation manager" — how much of it is already ratified, and what's actually still open
summary: Grounds decision #3427 (a real execution chokepoint every command routes through). Surveys the operations engine already shipped under epic #3029 (#3031's declared-once/generated-callers statute, #3405's dispatched-agent doctrine, #3421/#3422's missing-operation catalog-growth ruling) against #3427's own four framing bullets, and finds three of the four already ratified or already reasoned in shipped code — leaving exactly two live axes: the catalog's candidacy-scope boundary, and whether cheap/read-only calls should carry any telemetry at all given the existing run-store deliberately skips them.
